name: voronoi-bubble
description: Create easy Voronoi treemap HTML from tidy-style rows with colors, positioning hints, and readable labels.

interface.shortDescription: Generate readable Voronoi treemap HTML examples.
interface.longDescription: Helps ChatGPT, Codex, and coding agents turn tidy-style flat rows into easy Voronoi treemap examples with VoronoiBubble, including direct group/subgroup/item/size mapping, simple group colors, positive/negative sentiment colormaps, position hints, label-overlap-aware rendering, CDN-based single-file HTML, local bundle variants, and popup templates.
defaultPrompt: Create a Voronoi treemap HTML chart from this data with click popups.
Map these columns to group, subgroup, item, and size for VoronoiBubble.
Generate an offline VoronoiBubble HTML example using the local UMD bundle.
